headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of August 12, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 26.48% compared to SPY's 13.99%. This outperformance translates to an average alpha of 12.49%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved a remarkable return of 48.88%, significantly contributing to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 17.77%, which is still above the SPY return but less impactful. This relative strength against SPY is particularly noteworthy during periods of market uncertainty, as it suggests resilience in the portfolio's performance. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
